title: Inhibition of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) virus by a peptide derived from vFLIP through its direct destabilization of viruses
summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened the packet handoff, XML/PDF/OA package, supplement PDF text, locator index, and linked DRAMP rows. The paper is publication-grade with cautions: source-supported TAT-Kα2 sequence, all Table 2 antiviral/negative rows, cytotoxicity context, and direct envelope-destabilization mechanism are recorded, while unsupported DRAMP metadata remains source_conflict instead of being smoothed into source_verified.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata; Table 1 peptide sequences; Table 2 IC50/no-effect matrix; results/discussion/mechanism/method sections

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text corroborated Table 1, Table 2, cytotoxicity, virucidal mechanism, and methods

oa_package.coverage: OA archive members listed and extracted NXML/PDF/supplement/figures used where relevant

supplementary_assets.coverage: Supplement is figure-caption PDF text S1-S6 plus landing HTML assets; no spreadsheet/structured supplement table was present to change Table 2 database/activity decisions

merged_database_rows.coverage: 1 DRAMP activity row, 1 experiment row, and 1 literature row reviewed against primary source

supplementary_assets.note: Supplemental local material contains figure captions and article landing HTML duplicates, not unparsed spreadsheets or tables needed to change the worker-4/6 decision.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Accepted with cautions: packet status remains material_extracted_with_gaps from the framework test, but paper-local XML/PDF/OA package/supplement/database surfaces needed for the worker-4/6 blockers were available and reopened.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural validator/message-transfer readiness is separate from semantic acceptance; publication-grade status is based on this source-reviewed repair and fresh gates.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: DRAMP31535 sequence/name/citation/antiviral values/mechanism are source-reviewed; generic antimicrobial and free-terminus metadata remain source_conflict/database-only cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted with cautions at final layer: final activity now preserves all Table 2 rows, including RSV and the two No rows for non-enveloped viruses, plus source-supported MDCK no-cytotoxicity context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: direct envelope destabilization is source-supported by timing, sedimentation, infectivity, HA, TEM, and specificity evidence; exact pore/carpet-like mechanism remains bounded as hypothesis.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted_with_cautions after worker-4/6 source review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 and left no blocking or major quality-feedback issue.

caution_findings.note: Packet still carries material_extracted_with_gaps from the message-transfer test, but XML/PDF/OA-package/supplement/database surfaces needed for worker-4/6 were present and reopened.
DRAMP generic antimicrobial label and free N/C terminus annotations are not directly supported by the primary paper and remain source_conflict/database-only cautions.
The earlier final activity omitted the Table 2 RSV row and labeled viral targets as bacteria; final activity now preserves all 12 Table 2 source rows with viral target class.
Envelope destabilization is direct-source supported; exact pore/carpet-like molecular details and autophagy linkage remain unpromoted hypotheses/context.

non_negotiable_rules_applied: No missing value was fabricated; unsupported DRAMP free-terminus and generic antimicrobial metadata remain source_conflict/database-only cautions.
The missing RSV source row and the two non-enveloped No rows were restored from Table 2 rather than inferred from DRAMP.
Mechanism hypotheses about exact membrane pore/carpet details were not promoted beyond the source evidence.
Publication-grade status was not recorded until rework_targets were emptied and the ticket closure was made durable in quality_feedback/rework response surfaces.
